conventions.rotY: degrees about +Y, three.js sense: 0 faces -Z (north), 90 faces -X (west), 180 faces +Z, -90 faces +X
conventions.box: pos = centre, size = full extents [x,y,z], rotated by rotY
conventions.ramp: box footprint; top surface rises from pos.y - size.y/2 at the low edge to pos.y + size.y/2 at the high edge along local `rise` (+x|-x|+z|-z points uphill); solid beneath down to pos.y - size.y/2 - skirt
conventions.cylinder: pos = centre, size = [diameter, height, diameter]; innerRadius makes a tube or annulus
conventions.heightfield: reserved; not used in version 1 (the gully is wedge ramps; the art pass sculpts terrain over them)
conventions.markerPos: centre of the bottom face for volumes, floor-standing things and doors; the anchor point for wall-mounted and hanging things
conventions.markerSize: volumes: [x,y,z] extents before rotY; doors: [width, height, thickness] with local X = width, pos at the centre of the thickness; hatch (params.kind = hatch): [x, thickness, z]

solidFlags.dynamic: collider is off until enabledBy fires
solidFlags.playerOnly: collides with bodies only: shots, sight and aim tests pass through
solidFlags.low: cover below 2 m: does not hide a standing player
solidFlags.dress: free-text dressing hint for the art pass (not an asset binding)

conventions.seam: A solid, marker or nav node carrying `sets: [..]` is resident in EVERY listed set instead of only its zone's set. Used once: peg-stair flight 1, landing 1 and the shaft walls round them (flag `seam`), which are walked while surface is resident and stay when it unloads. Colliders, greybox and bake must include them in both sets.
conventions.zonePriority: zones carry `priority` (interior 10, exterior 0). zoneAt(x,y,z,set): of the zones of that set whose bounds contain the point, the highest priority wins. tally_house therefore wins the 2 m strip it shares with plenty_street, and its bounds reach down to y -5.5 so the seam is tally_house until trg_set_swap, the_gallery after.
conventions.storyKeys: a nar_/stn_/rv_/hint_ key is played from exactly one place (params lines / line / thenLine / parley / hints, or an encounter wave or onClear). pointerLine and alsoPlaysWhen name a second, conditional use of a line that is once-only. Each obj_* key is set by exactly one marker or encounter (GDD 12.2).
conventions.portals: nav.portals[].transform is the rigid teleport of a ride: p' = to + R(yawDeg) * (p - from), yaw' = yaw + yawDeg, about +Y. The two cages of a ride have identical interiors.
conventions.moods: docs/ART_BIBLE.md section 3: L0 overhang/glare, L1 Long Light, L2 Tally House, L3 stair and gallery, L4 lift hall, L5 bore, L6 blue hour
conventions.residentSets: zones carry `set` (surface | underground | coda). Sets are never resident together, so zone bounds of different sets may overlap in world space (the_lip / far_rim).
conventions.nav: nodes sit on the floor (y = floor height). links are undirected straight walks, verified clear for a 0.45 m radius body (1.0 m in lift_hall, for the Tamper). nav.gates lists links that cross a door marker. nav.portals are the two lift rides (teleports). Node tags: firing_point (Transit), problem_position, bay_inner / bay_mid / rib_shelter (bore), seam (peg-stair flight 1 and landing 1), knot_stand (where knot_hatch_latch is shot from).
